title: My Family's Jobs
text:
My father is a doctor. He works in a big hospital in the city. Every morning he helps sick people and listens to their problems.

My mother is a teacher. She teaches English to children at a small school. She likes her job because she loves to help students learn.

questions.text: Why does the mother like her job?
options: Because she earns a lot of money
Because she can help children learn
Because the school is near her house

questions.text: What can we guess about the father?
options: He does not like his work
He helps people when they are ill

vocabulary.definition: a place where doctors help sick people
a person whose job is to teach students
the work that a person does to earn money
makes it easier for someone to do something

paragraph_translations: Babam doktor. Şehirdeki büyük bir hastanede çalışıyor. Her sabah hasta insanlara yardım eder ve onların sorunlarını dinler.
Annem öğretmen. Küçük bir okulda çocuklara İngilizce öğretiyor. İşini seviyor, çünkü öğrencilerin öğrenmesine yardım etmeyi seviyor.
